template.name: Time Zone Pivots Open System
template.notes: On daily bars the StartHour 0 anchor is the session open, so the band is open plus/minus a 0.5x ATR(14) width standing in for the 100-price-step OffsetPoints, and the required preceding neutral bar is approximated by a non-positive one-bar return. SignalBar 1, StopLossPoints 1000, TakeProfitPoints 2000 and the duplicate-entry postponement are not long-signal or percent fields.
